column1: 0 disables dynamic block caching. Only blocks explicitly marked cacheable use this value.
column2: 0 关闭动态块缓存。只有显式标记为可缓存的 block 使用该值。

column1: A deeper path bypasses the cache. This caps crawler-generated URL variants. Default is 8.
column2: 更深的路径会绕过缓存。用于限制爬虫生成的 URL 变体。默认 8。

column1: A larger page bypasses the local cache. Default is 2 MB.
column2: 超过该大小的页面不进入本地缓存。默认 2 MB。

column1: A URL leaves the queue after this many failed attempts. Default is 3.
column2: URL 失败达到该次数后移出队列。默认 3。

column1: Ajax works without a reverse proxy. ESI requires a proxy that resolves esi:include; local mode always uses Ajax.
column2: Ajax 无需反向代理。ESI 需要能解析 esi:include 的代理；本地模式始终使用 Ajax。

column1: Base delay before a retry, multiplied by the attempt number. Default is 300.
column2: 重试前的基础等待秒数，乘以尝试次数。默认 300。

column1: Comma-separated. A request with any other query parameter bypasses the cache.
column2: 逗号分隔。包含其他 query 参数的请求会绕过缓存。

column1: Deepest layered-navigation combination still cached. Each extra segment and each -- joined value counts as one. Default is 2.
column2: 仍会缓存的最深分层导航组合。每个额外路径段和每个用 -- 连接的值都算一层。默认 2。

column1: Hit + revalidated over hit + miss + revalidated

column1: Invalid page cache mode. Choose Proxy, Revalidating or Local.
column2: 页面缓存模式无效。请选择代理、重新验证或本地。

column2: 队列中的最大 URL 数。达到上限时丢弃最旧的条目。默认 10000。

column1: Maximum URLs processed by one cron run. Default is 50.
column2: 单次 cron 处理的最大 URL 数。默认 50。

column1: One full action name per line, for example catalog_product_view.
column2: 每行一个完整 action 名称，例如 catalog_product_view。

column1: One full action name per line. Requests without a Maho session cookie skip session start on these routes.
column2: 每行一个完整 action 名称。没有 Maho session cookie 的请求在这些路由上跳过 session 启动。

column1: Only anonymous GET requests on the configured routes are affected.
column2: 仅影响配置路由上的匿名 GET 请求。

column1: Only PHP-side events are counted. Static file, reverse proxy and CDN hits do not run PHP and are not included.
column2: 仅统计 PHP 侧事件。静态文件、反向代理和 CDN 命中不运行 PHP，不计入统计。

column1: Optional HTTP basic auth user for warmup requests. Use only over HTTPS.
column2: 预热请求使用的 HTTP basic auth 用户。仅在 HTTPS 下使用。

column1: Output X-Maho-Cache-Tags, X-Maho-Cache-Version and detailed bypass reasons.
column2: 输出 X-Maho-Cache-Tags、X-Maho-Cache-Version 和详细 bypass 原因。

column1: Pause between concurrent request batches. Default is 500. Set 0 to disable.
column2: 并发请求批次之间的暂停毫秒数。默认 500。设为 0 关闭。

column1: Proxy stores HTML in a reverse proxy or CDN. Revalidating asks the proxy to revalidate every request with ETag or Last-Modified. Local stores full page HTML in Maho's cache and skips layout generation on a hit.
column2: 代理模式把 HTML 存入反向代理或 CDN。重新验证模式要求代理用 ETag 或 Last-Modified 校验每个请求。本地模式把完整页面 HTML 存入 Maho 缓存，命中时跳过 layout 生成。

column1: Queues invalidated pages and warms them from cron. Default is off.
column2: 把失效页面加入队列，并由 cron 预热。默认关闭。

column1: Rebuild explicitly marked leaf blocks during local mode hits. Proxy and static hits keep the anonymous fallback.
column2: 本地模式命中时重建显式标记的 leaf block。代理和静态命中保留匿名 fallback。

column1: Recent flush, purge and warmup events
column2: 最近刷新、清理和预热事件

column1: Records PHP-side page cache events in the database. Static, proxy and CDN hits do not run PHP and are not counted.
column2: 把 PHP 侧页面缓存事件记录到数据库。静态文件、代理和 CDN 命中不运行 PHP，不计入统计。

column1: Render Server-side Blocks on Local Hits
column2: 本地命中时服务器端渲染 block

column1: When enabled, a request with Cache-Control: no-cache bypasses the cache.
column2: 启用后，带 Cache-Control: no-cache 的请求会绕过缓存。

column2: 把匿名默认页写入 var/page-cache/static，供 nginx 或 Caddy 直接返回。需要配置 Web 服务器、缓存目录 deny 规则和清理 cron。第一版仅支持单节点。
仅默认 Context（仅 URL 代理）

column2: 代理遵守 Vary: Cookie 时使用 Cookie。仅默认 Context 适用于只按 URL 缓存的代理；通过 cookie 切换 store 的请求会 bypass。

column1: Maximum dynamic block requests per client in the window. 0 disables the limit.
column2: 每个客户端在窗口内允许的动态块请求数。0 关闭限制。

column1: Window for the dynamic request limit. Default is 60 seconds.
column2: 动态请求限制的窗口。默认 60 秒。

column1: The hourly cron logs a warning when the oldest pending stock invalidation is older than this. 0 disables the warning.
column2: 最老的待处理库存失效超过该秒数时，每小时 cron 记录 warning。0 关闭告警。

column2: 定时预热已关闭。请在 系统 > 配置 > 页面缓存 > 预热 中启用后再使用立即预热。

column2: 定时预热已关闭。请先启用再预热队列。

column2: 当前没有到期的 URL。队列中还有 %d 个 URL。

column2: 已处理 %d 个 URL：预热=%d 跳过=%d 失败=%d 丢弃=%d 剩余=%d。

column1: Warmup failed. Check the logs and try again.
column2: 预热失败，请检查日志后重试。

column2: 完整模式记录每个请求事件。采样模式按比例记录请求。Purge、Flush 和 Warmup 事件始终完整记录。

column1: Fraction from 0 to 1. For example 0.05 records about 5% of request events when mode is Sampled.
column2: 0 到 1 之间的小数。例如 0.05 在采样模式下记录约 5% 的请求事件。

column1: Statistics are sampled at %s. Counts are estimates, not exact totals. Purge, flush and warmup events are recorded completely.
column2: 统计按 %s 采样。计数为估算值，不是精确总量。Purge、Flush 和 Warmup 事件仍完整记录。

column1: Store gzip HTML when it is smaller than plain. The HTML size limit is in General.

column2: 小于该值的页面不压缩。默认 4096。

column2: 每行一个 origin，例如 https://www.example.com。scheme、host 和 port 必须完全匹配。用于预热需要访问的 store 别名域名。

column1: How many times a purge hand-off is tried before the row is marked failed.
column2: purge 投递失败后最多尝试多少次，超过后标记为 failed。

column2: 指数退避的基础秒数。每次失败后间隔翻倍。

column1: Log a warning when the oldest pending purge is older than this. Default is 3600.
column2: 最老的 pending purge 超过该秒数时记录 warning。默认 3600。

column1: How long delivered and failed outbox rows are kept for status. Default is 7.
column2: delivered 和 failed 行保留多少天用于状态查询。默认 7。

column1: A claimed row returns to pending when its lease expires. Default is 300.
column2: 已领取的行在租约过期后回到 pending。默认 300。

column1: Record tag and full invalidations in the page cache audit table. Independent from request statistics.
column2: 把 tag 和全量失效记录到页面缓存审计表。独立于请求统计。

column2: 每条记录最多保存多少个 tag 名。总数始终保存。默认 20。

column2: 部分页面缓存功能尚未开启。开启后可收集统计并预热缓存。
